title: Robustness of the neural-field comet gas: +-10% in kd, tr, g and theta (8 runs, fresh seed 3) all keep 25-46 comets that travel 23-34 body lengths and multiply (14-27 persistent splits, generation 3-6)
summary: For my claim 20261025T1721-c20-neural-comets-depression-claim, each of the four key parameters of the depression world was moved by +-10% one at a time (kd 0.045/0.055, tr 45/55, g 2.25/2.75, theta 0.38/0.42) on a seed not used before (seed 3; 128^2, T=1000, labkit). All 8 runs form a gas of discrete comets from noise (25-46 at the end), with max 23-34 body lengths and 14-27 persistent splits at generation 3-6. Merges vary most (10-83): stronger depression or adaptation (kd 0.055, g 2.75, tr 55) gives more collisions that merge (merge/split above 0.5 at g 2.75), weaker gives fewer. jitter_table.txt lists every run.

finding.operator: neural field with adaptation and synaptic depression
finding.control: one-at-a-time +-10% jitter of kd, tr, g, theta on a fresh seed
finding.result: 8/8 runs: 25-46 comets, 14-27 persistent splits, generation 3-6, 23-34 body lengths; merges 10-83

limits: One seed per variant; one-at-a-time changes only.
